# Artur Silva - PPGGMP

> Pacotes utilizaods

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vcfR)
library(DT)
```

# 1. Carregar VCF Anotado

```{r}
# Ler VCF
vcf <- read.vcfR("no_maf_no_repeat/snps_dalata_annotated.norepeats60.vcf.gz", verbose = FALSE)

cat("Total de variantes:", nrow(vcf), "\n")
cat("Amostras:", ncol(vcf@gt) - 1, "\n")
```

# 2. Extrair Anotações SnpEff

```{r}
# Extrair campo INFO
info <- vcf@fix %>% as.data.frame()

# Extrair ANN (anotação do SnpEff)
extract_ann <- function(ann_string) {
  if (is.na(ann_string) || ann_string == "") return(NULL)
  
  # ANN format: Allele|Annotation|Impact|Gene_Name|Gene_ID|...
  ann_fields <- str_extract(ann_string, "ANN=([^;]+)")
  if (is.na(ann_fields)) return(NULL)
  
  ann_fields <- str_remove(ann_fields, "ANN=")
  annotations <- str_split(ann_fields, ",")[[1]]
  
  # Parse primeira anotação (mais severa)
  first_ann <- str_split(annotations[1], "\\|")[[1]]
  
  data.frame(
    Annotation = first_ann[2],
    Impact = first_ann[3],
    GeneName = first_ann[4],
    GeneID = first_ann[5],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Aplicar para todas as variantes
variants <- info %>%
  mutate(ANN_data = map(INFO, extract_ann)) %>%
  unnest(ANN_data, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
  select(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, Annotation, Impact, GeneName, GeneID)

cat("Variantes anotadas:", sum(!is.na(variants$Impact)), "\n")
```

# 3. Resumo de Impacto

```{r}
impact_summary <- variants %>%
  filter(!is.na(Impact)) %>%
  count(Impact) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n/sum(n)*100, 1))

knitr::kable(impact_summary, col.names = c("Impact", "Total", "%"))
```

```{r}
coding_summary <- variants %>%
  filter(Annotation %in% c(
    "missense_variant",
    "stop_gained",
    "synonymous_variant"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Variant_Type = case_when(
      Annotation == "missense_variant" ~ "MISSENSE",
      Annotation == "stop_gained" ~ "NONSENSE",
      Annotation == "synonymous_variant" ~ "SILENT"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Variant_Type, name = "Total") %>%
  complete(
    Variant_Type = c("MISSENSE", "NONSENSE", "SILENT"),
    fill = list(Total = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(Total / sum(Total) * 100, 2)
  )

knitr::kable(
  coding_summary,
  col.names = c("Variant class", "Total", "Percentage (%)"),
  caption = "Distribution of coding variant consequences"
)
```


```{r}
impact_summary %>%
  mutate(Impact = factor(Impact, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Impact, y = n, fill = Impact)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HIGH" = "#d62728", "MODERATE" = "#ff7f0e",
                                "LOW" = "#2ca02c", "MODIFIER" = "#1f77b4"),
                    na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Distribuição de Variantes por Impacto", y = "Total") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 4. Tipos de Anotação

```{r}
annotation_summary <- variants %>%
  filter(!is.na(Annotation)) %>%
  count(Annotation, Impact) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (n / sum(n)) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Percentage, 2)) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      Annotation = "...",
      Impact = "...",
      n = NA_integer_,
      Percentage = NA_real_
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  annotation_summary,
  col.names = c("Variant consequence", "Impact", "Total", "Percentage (%)")
)
```

```{r fig.height=6}
annotation_summary %>%
  mutate(Impact = factor(Impact, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Annotation, n), y = n, fill = Impact)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HIGH" = "#d62728", "MODERATE" = "#ff7f0e",
                                "LOW" = "#2ca02c", "MODIFIER" = "#1f77b4"),
                    na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Tipos de Variantes", x = "Tipo", y = "Total") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 5. Análise por Gene

```{r}
genes_summary <- variants %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneName), GeneName != "") %>%
  group_by(GeneName, GeneID) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    HIGH = sum(Impact == "HIGH", na.rm = TRUE),
    MODERATE = sum(Impact == "MODERATE", na.rm = TRUE),
    LOW = sum(Impact == "LOW", na.rm = TRUE),
    MODIFIER = sum(Impact == "MODIFIER", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

cat("Genes afetados:", nrow(genes_summary), "\n")
cat("Genes com HIGH impact:", sum(genes_summary$HIGH > 0), "\n")
```

## Top 20 Genes

```{r}
genes_summary %>%
  head(20) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig.height=6}
genes_summary %>%
  head(20) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(HIGH, MODERATE, LOW), names_to = "Impact", values_to = "Count") %>%
  filter(Count > 0) %>%
  mutate(Impact = factor(Impact, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(GeneName, Count, sum), y = Count, fill = Impact)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HIGH" = "#d62728", "MODERATE" = "#ff7f0e", "LOW" = "#2ca02c")) +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Genes Mais Afetados", x = "Gene", y = "Variantes") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 6. Variantes HIGH Impact

```{r}
high_variants <- variants %>%
  filter(Impact == "HIGH") %>%
  select(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, Annotation, GeneName, GeneID)

cat("Total HIGH impact:", nrow(high_variants), "\n")
```

```{r}
if (nrow(high_variants) > 0) {
  datatable(high_variants, 
            caption = "Variantes de Alto Impacto (HIGH)",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
            rownames = FALSE)
}
```

# 7. Genes de Alto Impacto Funcional

```{r}
functional_genes <- genes_summary %>%
  filter(HIGH > 0 | MODERATE >= 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(HIGH), desc(MODERATE))

cat("Genes com alto impacto funcional:", nrow(functional_genes), "\n")
cat("  - Com variantes HIGH:", sum(functional_genes$HIGH > 0), "\n")
cat("  - Com ≥5 MODERATE:", sum(functional_genes$MODERATE >= 5), "\n")
cat("\nCandidatos para estudos de diversidade e adaptação\n")
```

```{r}
datatable(functional_genes,
          caption = "Genes com Alto Impacto Funcional",
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
          rownames = FALSE,
          filter = 'top')
```

# 8. Variantes Loss of Function (LOF)

```{r}
# Extrair informação LOF do campo INFO
info_lof <- vcf@fix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, INFO)

extract_lof <- function(info_string) {
  if (is.na(info_string) || info_string == "") return(NULL)
  
  lof_field <- str_extract(info_string, "LOF=\\(([^)]+)\\)")
  if (is.na(lof_field)) return(NULL)
  
  # LOF format: Gene_Name | Gene_ID | Number_of_transcripts | Percent_affected
  lof_content <- str_remove(lof_field, "LOF=\\(")
  lof_content <- str_remove(lof_content, "\\)")
  lof_parts <- str_split(lof_content, "\\|")[[1]]
  
  data.frame(
    LOF_GeneName = lof_parts[1],
    LOF_GeneID = lof_parts[2],
    LOF_Transcripts = lof_parts[3],
    LOF_Percent = lof_parts[4],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

lof_variants <- info_lof %>%
  mutate(LOF_data = map(INFO, extract_lof)) %>%
  unnest(LOF_data, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LOF_GeneName)) %>%
  select(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, LOF_GeneName, LOF_GeneID, LOF_Transcripts, LOF_Percent)

cat("Variantes LOF identificadas:", nrow(lof_variants), "\n")
cat("Genes afetados por LOF:", n_distinct(lof_variants$LOF_GeneName), "\n")
```

```{r}
if (nrow(lof_variants) > 0) {
  datatable(lof_variants,
            caption = "Variantes Loss of Function (LOF) - Perda de Função Gênica",
            options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
            rownames = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(lof_variants) > 0) {
  lof_genes <- lof_variants %>%
    count(LOF_GeneName, name = "LOF_Count") %>%
    arrange(desc(LOF_Count)) %>%
    head(15)
  
  knitr::kable(lof_genes, 
               col.names = c("Gene", "Variantes LOF"),
               caption = "Top 15 Genes com Variantes LOF")
}
```

# 9. Variantes Missense

```{r}
  select(CHROM, POS, GeneName, GeneID, Impact)

cat("Variantes missense:", nrow(missense_variants), "\n")
```

```{r}
if (nrow(missense_variants) > 0) {

}
```

# 10. Distribuição Cromossômica

```{r}
chrom_summary <- variants %>%
  filter(!is.na(Impact)) %>%
  count(CHROM, Impact) %>%
  group_by(CHROM) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

# Top 10 cromossomos
top_chroms <- head(unique(chrom_summary$CHROM), 10)
```

```{r fig.height=6}
chrom_summary %>%
  filter(CHROM %in% top_chroms) %>%
  mutate(Impact = factor(Impact, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(CHROM, -Total), y = n, fill = Impact)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HIGH" = "#d62728", "MODERATE" = "#ff7f0e",
                                "LOW" = "#2ca02c", "MODIFIER" = "#1f77b4"),
                    na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Distribuição de Variantes nos Top 10 Cromossomos",
       x = "Cromossomo", y = "Variantes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
